page.overview:
Who is Folmarv Tengille?

Folmarv Tengille, also known as Vormav Tingel, is the main antagonist of Final Fantasy Tactics. The patriarch of the House Tengille and leader of the Knights Templar of the corrupt Church of Glabados, Folmarv is the mastermind behind the hunt for the Zodiac Stones and the War of the Lions in Ivalice. A manipulative and cruel individual, Folmarv uses and disposes of many in his quest for his own agenda.

Like his daughter Meliadoul, Folmarv is a divine knight, meaning he can use a group of sword moves that can break his foe's equipment.

Folmarv has been a member of the Knights Templar in service to the Church of Glabados at least since the time of the Fifty Years' War. He had two children, Meliadoul and Isilud, who followed in his footsteps and became warriors devoted to the Church. Though the exact circumstances and timeline of these events remain unknown, after gaining the Leo Stone and being possessed by Hashmal through it Folmarv secretly began to lead an effort to revive the Angel of Blood, Ultima. Further corrupting the Church of Glabados and many of its high-ranking officials, Folmarv became to be seen as High Confessor Marcel's right-hand man.

High Confessor Marcel V believed Folmarv was searching for the Zodiac Stones to restore the Church's influence and was not expecting the eventual betrayal. Folmarv's right-hand men in the Knights Templar, meanwhile, believed that Folmarv was the second coming of Saint Ajora and was acting to restore the Zodiac Braves. Many of the Knights Templar, including Folmarv's right-hand men Loffrey Wodring and Cletienne Duroi, as well as his children, were unaware of the Lucavi plot, and ended up being used as pawns by them.
